items.title: Aptiv (APTV) Deepens Its Push Into Production Ready Automated Driving
items.summary: Aptiv (NYSE:APTV) announced an expanded collaboration with NVIDIA to supply scalable automated-driving solutions using NVIDIA Hyperion and Halos. The partners plan to offer production-ready systems that automakers can integrate into next-generation vehicles using modular hardware and software architectures.
